Title: Insights Solutions Partner II

Description: About Pinterest Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here. Pinterest’s Sales Insights team transforms first-party platform data, consumer research and market intelligence into compelling stories that help advertisers understand their audiences and grow their businesses. As an Insights Solutions Partner based in Mexico City, you will support Pinterest’s advertising business in Mexico by developing insight-led narratives that address important advertiser and sales priorities. You will work at the intersection of analytics, research, strategy and commercial partnership, using data to identify opportunities and turn them into clear, actionable recommendations. You will independently deliver insight projects using first-party behavioural data, third-party research and relevant market context. You will partner closely with Sales and other cross-functional teams, present your work to advertisers and agencies, and contribute to improving the tools, frameworks and AI-enabled workflows used by the wider Insights team. What You’ll Do Analyze Pinterest first-party platform data using SQL to uncover audience, category, cultural and commercial insights relevant to advertisers in Mexico. Translate complex datasets and research into persuasive, actionable narratives that support advertiser objectives and Pinterest’s revenue priorities. Partner with Sales to understand advertiser needs, identify the underlying business question and prioritise high-value insight opportunities. Use third-party syndicated research, market intelligence and other credible sources to strengthen first-party analysis and provide wider context. Present insights and recommendations to advertisers and agencies through meetings, workshops, presentations and other strategic engagements. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Creative, Measurement and regional or global Insights colleagues to deliver integrated advertiser solutions. Independently manage well-scoped, moderately complex projects, including stakeholder alignment, analytical planning, execution and quality assurance. Contribute to reusable analytical frameworks, sales narratives, templates and processes that extend the impact of insights beyond individual requests. Use Pinterest’s evolving AI toolkit to improve the speed, scale and quality of research, analysis, coding, narrative development and reporting. Critically evaluate AI-assisted work through source-checking, testing and data validation, maintaining ownership of all final outputs and recommendations. Monitor the adoption and commercial influence of insights, gathering feedback and applying learning to future work. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of relevant experience in insights, analytics, market research, consumer research, marketing strategy or a related analytical discipline. Minimum of 2 years of regular experience querying and manipulating data using SQL. Demonstrated experience using data to solve commercial or marketing challenges and influence stakeholder decisions. Strong insight storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into clear recommendations for different professional audiences. Experience building high-quality presentations in Google Slides, PowerPoint or an equivalent tool. Confidence presenting analytical work to clients, agencies or senior internal stakeholders. Ability to clarify ambiguous requests, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work independently. Working knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methods, audience research, market intelligence or syndicated data. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with commercial and cross-functional partners. Professional fluency in written and spoken Spanish and English. Experience using AI to accelerate analytical or research workflows, together with a clear approach to verifying accuracy, sources and quality. Experience in digital advertising, social platforms, media agencies, research agencies or consumer-facing technology is beneficial. Experience with advertisers or sectors relevant to the Mexican market is beneficial. Experience commissioning or managing primary research is beneficial. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience. An understanding of and enthusiasm for Pinterest’s mission, product and value to advertisers. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement We let the nature of the work guide how and where teams collaborate. We are not always working from an office, but we continue to gather for important moments of collaboration and connection. This role will need to work from the office for in-person collaboration approximately one to two times per week and must therefore be within a commutable distance of Pinterest’s Mexico City office. Description: 🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin? Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network , se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura. Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos? 🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro ✨ Creemos e inspiramos 🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños 🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo 🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar 🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia 🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología ¿Qué estamos buscando? En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte. Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos! Misión del rol Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado. Principales responsabilidades Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. You spend your time on validation and strategic interpretation. 13:30 – Knowledge Retrieval & Documentation You encounter a legacy pricing algorithm with no surviving documentation. You deploy an "Information Retrieval Agent" to parse thousands of historical Slack threads, Jira tickets, and GitHub commits. Within minutes, the agent provides a technical summary of the original design intent. You direct the agent to update the global metadata repository so this knowledge is permanently accessible to the organization. legacy algorithm overview/chage, retrieval across historical Slack / Jira / GitHub, technical summary, metadata repository update. leadership-triggered critical investigation search across SQL corpus, dbt lineage, notebook agents drafted explanations and SQL patches converting findings into a leadership action plan 15:30 – Defensive Systems Engineering You dedicate time to "Security & Integrity Engineering," building new "Red-Team Agents" whose sole purpose is to attempt to find flaws in the logic or security vulnerabilities in your other agents. You are building a self-healing digital immune system for the company's data. Agents prepare modeling and simulation workflows to test strategic scenarios such as pricing or renewal changes. The human selects methods, reviews assumptions, and interprets uncertainty before any decision is actioned. 18:00 – Asynchronous Task Deployment You initialize a long-tail analytical task: "Analyze the last 24 months of customer churn data and identify latent correlations that current linear models have missed." You disconnect while the agentic fleet begins the heavy compute and reasoning cycles overnight. 20:00+ – Long-Tail Agent Execution After hours, agents continue computationally heavy or long-horizon tasks, creating a curated queue of opportunities, risks, and partially completed work for the next morning. Contribuir al Directorio de Capacidades del CoE: publicar componentes, prompts, agentes y patrones reutilizables en el Registro institucional para evitar duplicidad entre las células de IA. RAG Avanzado e Integración de Sistemas: Implementación de estrategias complejas de recuperación de información (GraphRAG, búsqueda híbrida) y diseño API-First para conectar de forma ágil los modelos de IA con nuestros sistemas transaccionales y de negocio (BLM). Seguridad, Calidad y Observabilidad (LLMOps): Despliegue de modelos en producción garantizando su fiabilidad mediante evaluación rigurosa (RAGAS, DeepEval) y blindaje arquitectónico contra vulnerabilidades (OWASP, prompt injection). Visión de Negocio y Transformación de Workflows: Liderazgo para actuar como puente entre la ingeniería y los stakeholders, traduciendo necesidades operativas en soluciones técnicas y diseñando flujos de trabajo donde la IA actúa como un verdadero co-trabajador. Experiencia Sólida y Credenciales Cloud: Certificación obligatoria en IA/ML (AWS, Azure o GCP) respaldada por experiencia real llevando GenAI a producción (+1 año), arquitectura de soluciones empresariales (+2 años) e interacción directa con el negocio (+3 años). Inglés Intermedio B2 Ingeniería en Desarrollo de Software, Sistemas Computacionales, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Tecnologías de la Información o carrera afín.

Description: Director, Media Analytics - LATAM About Us SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja , the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. AI at SharkNinja At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in. Position Overview We're seeking a Director, Media Analytics – LATAM to lead full-funnel media measurement — spanning social, digital, retail, and traditional channels — across Mexico, Brazil, and the growing LATAM market. This is a player-coach role: you'll directly manage our Social Analytics Manager for the region today, while building the broader team and operating model this function will need as it grows. This role carries the same capabilities we're building across the org — AI-powered, agent-driven insight generation and strong stakeholder management — applied here across the full media mix, not just social. You'll be hands-on with the hardest analyses yourself while also shaping the longer-term vision for the team. Key Responsibilities Regional Leadership: Serve as the media analytics lead for LATAM, developing strategy while also executing hands-on analytics work across the full media mix. Team Management & Development: Directly manage the region's Social Analytics Manager today, while shaping the team's future headcount, roles, and structure as it scales. Full-Funnel Analytics: Lead measurement across all media types — digital, social, retail, and traditional — integrating data into a single, holistic view of performance. AI-Driven Insight Generation: Direct the use of AI agents against media and marketing data to surface signal faster — orchestrating intelligent tools against good data, not manual reporting. Signal Detection: Proactively identify signals, anomalies, or emerging patterns in media and market data to flag risks or opportunities before they escalate. Macro Analysis: Assess how media investment contributes not just to channel-level optimization but to overall business efficiency and growth. Stakeholder Management: Serve as the go-to analytics partner across a broad and growing set of stakeholders — regional marketing, brand, social, and finance leaders — managing competing priorities with clarity and poise.
